description: Create and pay for a Premier Letters order — a real, handwritten letter mailed via USPS. Requires a Premier Letters API key. Use get_pricing or preview_letter first to confirm the price. For payment, "card_on_file" charges the caller's saved card immediately, "balance" pays from the prepaid account balance (no small-order handling fee; fails with insufficient_balance when short), or "checkout_session" returns a checkout_url for the human to complete payment in a browser. Envelope return address: an explicit no_return_address_ack: true always wins; otherwise a supplied return_address, else the account default. With neither address, set no_return_address_ack: true to send without one.

extras.description: Optional extra pieces for each envelope (printed insert, printed letter, your own insert, flyer, business card…). Call list_extras for pieces, options and prices. "instant" pieces are charged with the order; "request" pieces are priced by staff afterwards and cost nothing now.

artwork_url.description: https URL of print-ready artwork (PDF/PNG/JPEG). Required for instant printed pieces.

note.description: Anything staff should know about this piece.

options.description: Option choices, e.g. { "size": "small", "color": "bw" }. Omitted options take the first choice.

quantity.description: Per recipient (default) or in total when scope is "flat". Default 1.

role.description: Write the handwritten letter ON this printed piece (printed letter, letter flyer, 4x6 postcard). Needs a pen-written letter of the matching product type.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key (1–255 chars). Repeating a call with the same key returns the original order instead of creating a second one. Always set this when you might retry.

message.description: The letter text. Supports {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{greeting}} merge fields per-recipient.

no_return_address_ack.description: Send with no return address at all. An explicit no_return_address_ack: true always wins; otherwise a supplied return_address, else the account default. Undeliverable mail is then destroyed.

options.description: handwriting_style, paper_type, product_type, mailing_option, authenticity_preset, include_letter, include_envelope, copies, output_mode ("handwritten" default; "facsimile" prints the handwriting on a laser printer; "printed_bw" / "printed_color" print typed text) and envelope_output_mode (null default = hand-addressed, or "facsimile" / "printed_bw" / "printed_color") — see /openapi.json for the full field list.

recipients.description: One or more recipients. At least one is required unless options.product_type is a letter/card with no envelope.

return_address.description: Return address written on the envelope. Omit to use the account's default return address. Required unless the account has a default or no_return_address_ack is true. An explicit no_return_address_ack: true always wins; otherwise a supplied return_address, else the account default. name, address_line1, city, state and zip are required unless return_address_partial_ok is true.

return_address_partial_ok.description: Send return_address exactly as written although it is incomplete: at least one of name, company, address_line1, city, state, zip. Only the filled lines print (a name alone is fine). Without it an incomplete return_address is refused.

skip_invalid.description: When true, invalid recipients are skipped instead of failing the whole order.

name: create_order
